Specification: This module is a dummy replacement for the standard TLA+ Integers module. It extends Naturals and provides placeholder definitions for integer-related operators, with comments explaining that tools such as TLC are expected to override these definitions with real implementations. The module defines the integer set Int as the empty set and defines the prefix negation operator in terms of subtraction, serving as a structural specification stub rather than a complete algorithmic system.
